correctness.rationale: Over complex binary decics, six transvectant quadrics from the cited Massri complete-intersection theorem cut a pure fourfold X of degree 2^6=64. The incidence P1 x P3 -> T, (ell,h) -> ell^7 h, is generically one-to-one because a degree-10 form cannot have two sevenfold roots. O(7,1)^4 has intersection number 28. Independently reconstructed the full six-row integer Jacobian at f=x^7(x^3+x²y+xy²+y³) in transverse coordinates a5..a10, row gcds 2438553600,4877107200,2438553600,9754214400,14631321600,73156608000 and primitive determinant -1890000. Rank six gives smoothness of X at a smooth point of T and generic component multiplicity one. The effective remaining four-cycle therefore has exact weighted degree 64-28=36, without any irreducibility assertion. The finite determinant proves a local rank only; the complete-intersection theorem is the nonlocal input.
